parent_objective: design family-specific source-repair grids for inactive and undercovered source families
blocked_by: M1318 routes M1317 partial source-positive result to inactive-family repair
supersedes: direct corpus export from the partial M1317 active-family subset

public_gates: M1319 must not use private holdout
M1319 must preserve actor input contract
M1319 must keep strict source acceptance thresholds
M1319 must design family-specific repair routes for inactive families
forbidden_shortcuts: do not relabel inactive families as accepted

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs targeted source-repair profiles for M1317 inactive and undercovered families
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: repair design only; no promotion, private-holdout, PPO, closed-loop, paper-level, high-fidelity, or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if design routes directly to PPO
stop if design relaxes source acceptance thresholds
stop if design requires actor input expansion
stop if design ignores global friction steering or load/CG blockers
fallback_plan: if repair design is admissible, implement one no-policy family-repair smoke
if a family cannot be represented, mark it simulator-extension-blocked
if scope is too broad, split repair smoke by family
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1318 routes partial coverage to family repair

admission_evidence: M1317 accepts 5 source families but leaves 3 inactive
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
next_stage_criteria: global friction repair route is explicit
steering actuator repair route is explicit
next no-policy implementation route is explicit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1319 is source-repair design and does not test closed-loop history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: design source repairs that can later produce richer command-response histories
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1317 and M1318 source generator coverage artifacts.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Families that remain action-equivalent must be marked blocked or separately repaired rather than accepted.
allowed_claims: no strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, high-fidelity validation, real-vehicle, paper-result, or closed-loop driver claim

hypothesis: Family-specific source-repair grids and action profiles can be designed for global friction, steering actuator, load/CG, and undercovered halfshaft cases without changing actor inputs or source thresholds.
success_criteria: design covers global friction, steering actuator, load/CG, and halfshaft undercoverage
no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: training, PPO, private holdout, promotion, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
decision_rule: M1319 passes if it designs family-specific no-policy repair routes without training, PPO, promotion, private holdout use, threshold relaxation, fake accepted-family labels, or actor-input expansion.
